protected_assets.description: Global managed Capability catalog and active immutable Skill packages

trusted_assumptions.description: Current user account, OS kernel and deterministic gate are trusted

in_scope_failures.description: A global Skill is copied or bound to one Project or Session
A failed install exposes a partial package or replaces the last valid catalog
Existing and new Sessions receive different Skill catalogs
UI reports success before receipt and runtime proof
Production traffic is wired through a legacy loader or dormant runtime

in_scope_adversaries.description: Malformed or malicious Skill Git content

maximum_acceptable_impact: A failure may reject only the current install and must preserve the prior valid global catalog.
